method.title: Step-by-step method
method.hint: A basic outline that fits any job.
method.body:
## When to use
Write in a sentence or two which requests this skill is for.

## Steps
1. Write what to do first.
2. Write the next step.
3. Write how to check the result.

## Keep in mind
- A rule to always follow.
- Something to avoid.

## Example request
> A sentence the user might write.

product.title: Product promo
product.hint: Promotes a product in a short video.
product.name: Product promo video
product.description: Prepares a short vertical video that promotes a product with its price and best feature.
product.body:
## When to use
When the user wants to promote a product or service with a short video.

## Steps
1. Take the product’s name, price and best feature from what is in memory.
2. Write an attention-grabbing opening line for the first 3 seconds.
3. Show the product in 2–3 short scenes; pick an image from the library for each.
4. Add a closing in the brand voice and a single call to action.

## Keep in mind
- Do not guess the price; if it is not in memory, ask the user.
- Keep the video under **30 seconds**.

## Example request
> Promote the pumpkin risotto in 20 seconds.

titles.title: Title and description
titles.hint: Writes a title, description and tags for a video.
titles.name: Title and description writing
titles.description: Writes title suggestions, a description and tags for a video.
titles.body:
## When to use
When the user asks for a title, description or tags for a video.

## Steps
1. Sum up the video’s main topic in one sentence.
2. Suggest 3 titles of at most 60 characters.
3. Write a description whose first two lines spark curiosity.
4. Add at most 10 tags.

## Keep in mind
- No exaggerated promises in the title.
- Follow the brand voice.

## Output format
- **Titles:** numbered list
- **Description:** at most 3 paragraphs
- **Tags:** one comma-separated line
